# [CS008] Unbounded Decompression (archive-decompression-bomb)

Compressed input is decompressed without a size limit.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-409](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/409.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A few kilobytes of gzip or zip data can expand to gigabytes, exhausting memory or disk. Copying a decompressor with io.Copy or io.ReadAll has no bound. Wrap the reader in io.LimitReader and treat hitting the limit as an error.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
zr, _ := gzip.NewReader(r.Body)
data, _ := io.ReadAll(zr)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
zr, err := gzip.NewReader(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1<<20))
if err != nil {
	return err
}
data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(zr, 10<<20))
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [archive-decompression-bomb]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    archive-decompression-bomb: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore archive-decompression-bomb -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** archive-decompression-bomb
```
